bpd.hero.h1: Foods that help reduce the risk of breast cancer
bpd.hero.lede: The clinic's original health-education article, published on its Facebook page — edited by Dr. Morjina Akhter.
bpd.fig.cap: Healthy foods — image from the clinic's education post
bpd.editorial: The article below is the clinic's own health-education article, published on its official Facebook page and edited by Dr. Morjina Akhter. It is reproduced here as it was originally published.
bpd.p1: The breast is a symbol of motherhood and beauty for women. Without awareness of breast cancer — a deadly disease — it can take away a woman's most precious life. Generally, the risk of this cancer is highest among people over 50 years of age. Men can also develop breast cancer, although the rate of breast cancer in men is very low. One estimate shows that in the United Kingdom about 41 thousand women are affected by breast cancer every year, compared with only 300 men affected by this disease. A healthy food list can greatly reduce the risk of breast cancer. Specific foods help fight the malignant cancer cells of breast cancer.
bpd.p2: Nature itself holds foods that are a great remedy for cancer and many other diseases of yours. Get to know those foods — and stay safe from the risk of breast cancer.
bpd.h2.foods: Foods that can help reduce the risk
bpd.f1.p: Pomegranate is especially helpful in preventing breast cancer. It contains an ellagic acid known as polyphenol and antioxidant elements. It helps prevent the growth of cancer. For its health benefits, add this fruit to your daily food list.
bpd.f2.p: Tomatoes are quite beneficial in reducing the risk of breast cancer among postmenopausal women. Tomatoes contain lycopene, which is a powerful antioxidant; it slows the growth of cancer cells and helps prevent the development of breast cancer. You can eat tomatoes cooked, mashed, or processed. However, for good results you should drink one and a half glasses of tomato juice daily.
bpd.f3.p: The carrot is a food rich in nutrients and vitamins. It also contains plenty of beta-carotene, which helps prevent various cancers such as lung cancer, throat (respiratory-tract) cancer, stomach cancer, bowel cancer and even breast cancer. Drinking a glass of carrot juice every day makes it possible to prevent all these cancers.
bpd.f4.p: Cauliflower and broccoli are highly nutritious vegetables rich in herbal elements. Like cabbage, broccoli is a fibre-rich vegetable that helps remove toxic substances from the body. Its galactose element is also very helpful in eliminating bacteria in the intestine. The sulforaphane and indoles in broccoli help reduce the risk of lung, bladder, lymphoma and breast cancers. It also contains a large amount of cancer-fighting phytonutrients.
bpd.f5.p: The element that fights against cancer is 'alium'. It is found in garlic in high amounts. Besides garlic, other spices of this kind — such as onion and onion-family plants — also contain this element. These help stop tumour growth and reduce the risk of colorectal and prostate cancers. Eating one clove of garlic every morning helps to keep the body free from cancer for life.
bpd.f6.p: Turmeric contains curcumin, which helps fight against cancer. It helps in the prevention of breast, gastrointestinal, lung and skin cancers. Research has shown that it fights widely against cancer because it contains cell-protectant and antioxidant properties with anti-inflammatory characteristics, which reduce the risk of cancer.
bpd.f7.p: Mushrooms contain beta-D glucan, lamptrol, terpin wedgroup benzopyrine tritterpin and adenosine, which help in the prevention of breast cancer.
bpd.f8.p: We already know much about the nutrition of eggs. The egg also works in the prevention of breast cancer. Eggs contain an element called choline, which lowers the risk of cancer. According to experts, every woman should have 425 milligrams of choline to help prevent cancer, while one egg contains 126 milligrams.
bpd.f9.p: Drinking green tea regularly reduces the risk of breast cancer. The phytochemical in green tea helps keep the body healthy.
bpd.f10.p: It builds up protection against the cancer cells responsible for breast cancer. The omega-3, lignans and fibre in flaxseed constantly fight against these cells. Flaxseed, whole flaxseed or flaxseed oil can be included in the diet.
bpd.f11.p: Walnuts contain much helpful nutrition and reduce the abnormal growth of breast-cancer tumours. Researchers at Marshall University advise eating about two ounces of walnuts daily. As a result, the activity of the multiple genes involved in breast cancer, which it helps change, is reduced.
bpd.close: Along with including these foods in your diet to fight breast cancer, you must always follow your doctor's advice too.
